title: Security Solutions Architect (Hands-On) — Supporting the USA CISO
description:
**The Role**

Sennovate is an AI-first cybersecurity MSSP and Google Cloud Security Partner: SOC/MDR, Identity, Cloud, Offensive Security and AI Governance, powered by Sennovate.ai (our agentic AI SOC on Google SecOps and Gemini Enterprise).

You are the hands-on technical engine behind our CISO. You win the technical argument in pre-sales, then make sure we deliver what we sold.

**What You Will Do**

* Pre-sales: run discovery, live demos and PoCs in the console; scope solutions; shape proposals, SOWs and RFP responses
* Support the CISO and sales on strategic US client engagements, including US-hours calls
* Hand off won deals to the India CISO and his team (requirements, architecture, scope, risks); guide delivery and review it against what was sold
* Design across SOC/MDR, IAM, IGA, PAM, DLP, EDR/XDR, cloud and offensive security
* AI security and governance: design and assess controls; build governance programs on NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act; shape offerings with the AI Innovation Hub
* Market insight: track US buyer needs and turn them into new solutions

**Who You Are**

* 10+ years in cybersecurity, engineer to architect, ideally at an MSSP, OEM or consulting firm. You know how services are sold, built and delivered
* Hands-on across IAM, IGA, PAM, DLP, EDR, XDR and SIEM/SOC
* Well versed in AI security and governance (required): NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs. You have assessed or built real programs
* Console-fluent on platforms such as Google SecOps, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender, Okta, Entra ID, SailPoint, CyberArk, Purview, Wiz and Elastic; scripting in Python or similar
* Proven pre-sales wins; able to lead and coach a delivery team
* Understands the US buyer; strong English; US-hours overlap
* Preferred: Multi-domain expertise; CISSP, CISM, CCSP; AIGP or ISO 42001

**Mindset**

See it. Own it. Solve it. Credibility to stand beside a CISO, drive of a builder. 10x.

**Not Looking For**

* Advisers who won't execute
* Anyone who wins the demo and leaves delivery to figure it out
* AI knowledge that is slideware
* Anyone who needs a large team or detailed instructions. We are lean
* Purely technical people uncomfortable in front of security leaders
* Anyone who checks ownership at the door. Culture fit is non-negotiable

**How We Hire and Culture**

We hire on evidence of ownership, depth and culture fit, not resume and vibe. Culture is King: "You get what you tolerate." Care for Each Other · Pride in the Work · Who, Not How · What, Why, When Before How · 10x Mindset · Uniqueability

title: Relationship Manager (Wealth mgmt.)
description:
**About Turtle**

Turtle is a fee-only, SEBI-registered investment advisory firm serving returning NRIs and high-income Indian professionals with full-stack, cross-border financial planning. No commissions, no product-pushing, just a fiduciary practice built around one moment: when a client actually feels the value of the knowledge we've handed them.

**The Role**

Our tech team has automated most of the repeatable, standard-process work: reminders, document chasers, scheduling nudges. What's left is the part that actually needs a human, catching the situation that doesn't fit the standard flow, and making the right call on it.

You'll sit between clients and advisors, watching for the moments automation can't handle: a client going quiet before a renewal, an advisor stuck on an unusual case, a process that's technically "done" but the outcome doesn't feel right. You fix it, and you tell the tech team what to build next.

**What You'll Do**

* Handle the exceptions, escalations, and judgment calls that fall outside our automated workflows
* Watch client and advisor journeys for early signs of something going sideways, before it becomes a problem
* Design and implement playbooks for repeatable, efficient client-advisor interactions
* Step in directly with clients or advisors when a human touch actually matters
* Work closely with the tech team: flag what should be automated next, and test what they build
* Own the edge cases and one-off requests that don't have a system built for them yet

**Who We're Looking For**

* Sharp judgment: knows the difference between "follow the process" and "this needs a real decision"
* Comfortable being the last line of defence when automation doesn't cover it
* Clear communicator, equally at ease with clients, advisors, and the tech team
* Curious about where the real gaps are, not just executing what's already defined
* Calm under pressure, especially when several things need attention at once

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline
* 3-5 years of experience in operations, client success, or relationship management
* Comfortable working alongside a tech team, translating real-world friction into clear requirements

**Preferred**

* Prior exposure to financial services, wealth management, or fintech
* Experience giving feedback that shaped a product, tool, or workflow

**What You'll Get**

* Real ownership of the human layer of client experience, not busywork the tech team has already solved
* A direct line to engineering; your feedback becomes their roadmap
* A close working relationship with founders and advisors, not a large hierarchy
* A front-row view of how a fiduciary advisory firm runs, end to end

*Interested candidates can reach out with their resume and a short note on a time they made a judgment call that a process couldn't to raj[at]turtlefinance[dot]in*

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Voxtron is a Dubai-headquartered AI-driven customer experience and digital transformation company with offices in the UAE, Qatar, Oman and India. title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About Neva

Neva Technologies builds AI tools and engineering support for the US construction industry. Our first customer is a US general contractor doing ~$250M a year in work. We are early stage, and building the first versions of our products directly against their real data: submittals, drawings, estimates, pay applications, and project files.

What you'll do

You will be an early engineer. You take a workflow from a project manager or estimator, rapidly build a custom AI tool from it, ship it, and keep it running. Each build has a user, a dataset, and a number that tells us whether it worked. The first few on the list:

* A cost-estimating tool that reads historical project data and a new set of plans and produces a rough budget with its assumptions stated.
* A pay-application checker that compares a subcontractor's monthly invoice against the schedule of values, prior invoices, lien waivers, and stored-material backup, and returns a discrepancy list.
* Be comfortable working with parallel teams building physical AI applications (~12 months after start).
* Claude skills and plugins that package our customer's working rules so every team gets the same result.
* Integrations with the tools contractors already use: Procore, Bluebeam, Microsoft 365.

You will talk directly to the people who use what you build, including the customer's executives, and you will be expected to tell them what the tool gets wrong.

Must have

* 3+ years building software, with Python as your main language and enough full-stack experience to ship a small web app on your own.
* Have shipped an LLM-backed tool to real users, including tool use or agents, and kept it running afterward.
* Can extract and structure data from PDFs, drawings, and messy spreadsheets.
* Build evaluations as a habit: a test set and a number, not "it looked right."
* Can deploy and operate what you build: cloud hosting, scheduled jobs, logging, and fixing it when it breaks.
* Have worked against third-party APIs and can judge whether an outside AI tool is good enough to use.
* Can explain what you built, and its limits, to a non-technical person.

Nice to have

* Construction, civil engineering, or AEC software exposure (Procore, Bluebeam, Revit).
* Experience as a forward-deployed or customer-facing engineer.
* Team management and hiring experience
* Comfortable living in Excel.

What you get

* You set the engineering bar for a team that will grow around you in 2027.
* Your work goes into production for a real US contractor within weeks, not quarters.
* Direct exposure to how an AI consulting and product business gets built from the first customer onward.

title: Senior Engineer - Studies
description:
We are seeking an experienced Power System Study Engineer with deep expertise in grid stability analysis, voltage and frequency control, and renewable integration. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience performing advanced power system studies using industry-standard tools such as PSCAD, PSS®E, and other simulation platforms. This role requires strong technical skills combined with the ability to present complex solutions to large industrial customers, bulk power consumers, and utilities.

**As a Project Engineer - Studies a typical day might include the following:**

Perform dynamic, transient, and steady-state studies for transmission and distribution networks, including:  
Grid stability analysis (voltage, frequency, rotor angle stability).  
Short-circuit, load flow, and contingency analysis.  
Renewable integration studies (wind, solar, hybrid systems).  
Develop mitigation strategies and stability recommendations for complex power systems.  
Model and simulate large industrial loads, bulk power consumers, and interconnection points.  
Conduct protection coordination and system reliability assessments.  
Prepare technical reports and presentations for customers, EPCs, and regulatory bodies.  
Collaborate with internal teams on project execution and proposal development.  
Stay updated on grid codes, compliance standards, and emerging technologies.

**This job might be for you if:**

Electrical Degree or Master's in Electrical Engineering (Power Systems specialization).  
Min 4years of experience in power system studies and analysis.  
Proficiency in PSCAD, PSS®E, and familiarity with other tools (ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory preferred).  
Strong understanding of:  
Dynamic and transient stability.  
Voltage and frequency control strategies.  
Renewable integration challenges.  
Proven ability to present technical solutions to customers and stakeholders.  
Excellent communication and report-writing skills.  
Preferred Skills:  
Experience with HVDC systems, FACTS devices, and grid modernization projects.  
Knowledge of IEC and IEEE standards related to power system studies.  
Ability to mentor junior engineers and contribute to skill development programs.

**Location**

Bengaluru - India
